name: pandoc
solution: `pandoc -f html -t gfm` fetches the page and converts it to Markdown, and a regular expression parses the Markdown into the records. It has no crawler. pandoc is not a Python package: the harness unpacks the official Windows release archive and puts its folder first on PATH, so a pandoc installed on the machine never runs. The pandoc project publishes no checksum, so the pinned SHA-256 is the digest that GitHub shows for the release asset, which matches the first download.

footnotes.text: The unpacked archive: `pandoc.exe`, its manual and its licence files. pandoc is not a Python package, so its package count reads 0.
